title: Battle of Hemmingstedt
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Hemmingstedt", at revision 1375929854, opens: "The Battle of Hemmingstedt occurred on 17 February 1500, south of the village of Hemmingstedt near the present village of Epenwöhrden in the western part of present-day Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. It was an attempt by King John of Denmark and his brother Duke Frederick, who were co-dukes of Schleswig and Holstein to subdue the peasantry of Dithmarschen, who had established a peasants' republic on the coast of the North Sea. John was, at the time, also king of the Kalmar Union." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q656190, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between Kalmar Union forces and Dithmarschen peasant militiamen 17 February, 1500 in modern-day Schleswig-Holstein, Germany". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
